title: Shellder Makes Pearls Then Throws Them Away
premise: Trapped sand inside Shellder's shell eventually becomes a pearl, but the pearl gets in the way, so Shellder spits it out.
audiencePromise: Follow sand into Shellder's shell, watch it become a pearl, then see where that pearl ends up.
openLoop: How does Shellder turn trapped sand into something it immediately discards?
payoff: Shellder's beautiful pearl is not treasure to keep. It is an obstruction to spit out.
engagementQuestion: Is Shellder a pearl maker or a pearl waster?

voice.instructions: Sound like a knowledgeable fan sharing a strange fact. Keep the pace quick, warm, and playful. Stress pearl, way, and spits it out. Pause briefly before the reveal.

scenes.headline: MAKES PEARLS. THROWS THEM.
scenes.narration: Shellder makes pearls, then throws them away.
scenes.caption: BEAUTIFUL. THEN GONE.

scenes.headline: SAND GETS TRAPPED
scenes.narration: Sand gets trapped inside Shellder's shell and mixes with body fluids.
scenes.caption: SAND + BODY FLUIDS

scenes.headline: SAND BECOMES A PEARL
scenes.narration: The sand eventually forms a beautiful pearl inside its shell.
scenes.caption: TRAPPED SAND → PEARL

scenes.headline: THE PEARL IS IN THE WAY
scenes.narration: But the pearl gets in the way, so Shellder spits it out.
scenes.caption: THE TREASURE BECOMES A PROBLEM

scenes.headline: PEARL: DISCARDED
scenes.narration: Its pearl-making ends with the finished pearl simply discarded.
scenes.caption: MADE BEAUTIFUL. THROWN AWAY.

scenes.headline: MAKER OR WASTER?
